source: User-supplied original MP3 files; Love, Wedding Entrance and Waltz copied byte-for-byte. Magic Wedding analyzed locally only and excluded from deployment.
method: Chrome decodeAudioData at 44100 Hz; mono 22050 Hz analysis, Hann STFT 1024/hop 256, positive log spectral flux with 41-frame local mean subtraction; autocorrelation 70–180 BPM; 0.5s RMS and 2s spectral-band novelty. Candidates are machine measurements, not human listening or definitive beat annotations. Refined tempo: 75–178 BPM in 0.05 BPM steps, 240-bin phase histogram with Gaussian weighting of measured attacks. Stereo full-buffer unweighted RMS/sample peak recorded independently. macOS afinfo confirms codec/rate/channel/container duration; ffprobe unavailable. No human listening or official musical score claimed.
